headlines.title: 陈茂波：香港将上调全年经济增长预测
headlines.summary: 香港财政司司长陈茂波8月2日发表司长随笔称，本港今年上半年经济增长为5.1%，较预期强劲。下半年商品出口料继续受惠全球对人工智能产品的强大需求；境外对本港金融及商业服务的需求持续，以及访港旅客的增加，均将带动服务输出增长，有利本地消费和投资气氛。综合考虑整体经济发展情况，本月中发表的经修订全年经济增长预测，将从原先预测的范围向上调整，惟未来走势仍受地缘政治局势发展、美息及其他不确定因素影响。我们将继续保持高度警惕，既大力加快发展经济，也守稳经济金融安全。

headlines.title_en: Chen Maobo: Hong Kong to raise full-year economic growth forecast
headlines.summary_en: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan said in his blog on Aug 2 that Hong Kong's economy grew 5.1% in the first half, stronger than expected. In H2, merchandise exports are expected to continue benefiting from strong global demand for AI products; sustained external demand for Hong Kong's financial and business services, along with more visitor arrivals, will drive services export growth, supporting local consumption and investment sentiment. Given overall economic conditions, the revised full-year growth forecast to be released this month will be raised from the original projected range, though the outlook remains subject to geopolitical developments, US interest rates, and other uncertainties. We will remain highly vigilant, vigorously accelerating economic development while safeguarding economic and financial security.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.title_en: Power Outages Across Multiple Provinces in Cuba
headlines.summary_en: Cuba's Electric Union reported on Aug. 1 that at 18:07 local time, a power outage hit the system from Matanzas Province to Pinar del Río Province. The union said on social media the outage was caused by a line trip. Due to U.S. sanctions, Cuba has long struggled to import fuel and power plant equipment, leaving aging plants hard to upgrade and the national power supply tight. Since October 2024, Cuba has suffered multiple nationwide blackouts due to equipment failures, hurricanes, and other causes. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: SAFE holds 2026 H2 foreign exchange management work exchange meeting
headlines.summary_en: On Aug 1, the State Administration of Foreign Exchange held its H2 2026 foreign exchange management work exchange meeting via video. The meeting deployed key tasks for H2 2026 foreign exchange management, including steadily expanding institutional opening of the foreign exchange sector. Trade facilitation reforms will be advanced, with a package of measures to optimize current account foreign exchange management, full promotion of high-level cross-border trade foreign exchange receipt and payment facilitation policies, support for new trade formats such as cross-border e-commerce, optimization of service trade foreign exchange settlement, and support for intermediate goods trade development. High-level opening of the capital account will be advanced in an orderly manner, with a package of cross-border investment and financing facilitation policies, nationwide promotion of centralized operation policies for cross-border funds of multinational corporations, introduction of regulations for domestic foreign exchange loans, and steady and prudent expansion of financial market connectivity.

headlines.summary:
Chinese families are fast retreating from real estate, with many holding large cash reserves now cautiously weighing stock investments, marking a stark contrast with South Korea, where retail investors are aggressively using leverage to fuel equity bets at home and abroad.

headlines.summary_zh: 中国家庭正快速撤离房地产市场，许多家庭持有大量现金，如今谨慎考虑股票投资，这与韩国形成鲜明对比——韩国散户投资者正积极利用杠杆在国内和海外市场进行股票押注。第一季度，房地产占家庭资产的比例降至52%。

headlines.summary:
Major Chinese cities including Shanghai are witnessing a significant uptick in commercial property transactions, as investors snap up space in prime locations in the expectation that the market may finally be on the road to recovery.
The value of office buildings, hotels and shopping malls across China has slumped in recent years amid a prolonged real estate crisis. But with prices in some cities now starting to stabilise, investors are hunting for potential bargains, according to analysts.

headlines.title_en: French PM's office issues statement on foreign investment regime: France tightens rules on non-European entities holding stakes in French companies
headlines.summary_en: The French Prime Minister's Office issued a statement on the foreign investment regime: France is tightening rules on non-European entities holding stakes in French companies. Non-European investors acquiring 10% or more of a French company's equity must obtain approval from the French Ministry of Finance.

headlines.title: 中国棉花协会：反对美方制裁打压中国棉纺织企业
headlines.summary: 中国棉花协会发表声明称，美方所谓“强迫劳动”的指控毫无事实与法理依据。中国棉花产业始终坚持市场化、现代化发展方向，新疆机采棉目前占比已超过90%，从种植、采摘到加工、纺织，全产业链均实现了高度自动化与规模化。此次制裁严重破坏了全球棉花产业链与供应链的稳定。棉花作为全球性的大宗商品，其产业链已高度国际化。美方此举损害了中国企业的合法权益。

headlines.title_en: China Cotton Association: Opposes US sanctions and suppression of Chinese cotton and textile enterprises
headlines.summary_en: The China Cotton Association issued a statement saying the U.S. allegations of so-called 'forced labor' are groundless in fact and law. China's cotton industry has consistently pursued market-oriented and modern development. Mechanized harvesting of Xinjiang cotton now accounts for over 90%, and the entire industrial chain—from planting, picking, and processing to textile production—is highly automated and scaled. The sanctions severely undermine the stability of the global cotton industry and supply chains. As a global commodity, cotton's industrial chain is highly internationalized. The U.S. action damages the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese enterprises.
